story.heading: Helpful, without becoming another thing to manage.
story.subtitle: Skintext is warm and clear when that helps, cautious when something looks wrong, and brief enough to fit real life.

snapOrText.heading: A routine you can live with.
snapOrText.body: Two steps you actually do beat ten that feel overwhelming. Skintext changes one thing at a time so you can see what helps.
snapOrText.point1: It describes visible details cautiously and avoids diagnosis.
snapOrText.point2: When a product should be remembered, it asks before saving it.

smartReminders.heading: Follow-ups, never guilt.
smartReminders.body: No streaks, shame, or sales pressure. Just a useful check-in when you want one, with reminders that stay opt-in.
smartReminders.point1: No invented morning or evening reminder defaults.
smartReminders.point2: One-off follow-ups and recurring reminders stay separate.

dailySummaries.heading: Context that stays useful.
dailySummaries.body: Products, reactions, and goals can carry between chats. Skintext asks before saving sensitive details, and you can delete them.
dailySummaries.point1: Routine status comes from verified logs, not guesses from chat.
dailySummaries.point2: Export and delete paths are part of the same data story.

Faq.heading: A few useful answers
Faq.a1: No. Skintext can describe visible features cautiously, explain product labels, and suggest practical routine steps. It does not diagnose or replace a clinician.
Faq.q2: What do I need to get started?
Faq.a2: Just an iPhone with iMessage. No app to download, no account to create. Text Skintext and set up your routine in a short chat.
Faq.a3: Only context that makes future help more useful, such as your routine, goals, products, and reactions. Skintext asks before saving sensitive details, and you can ask what it remembers or delete it.
Faq.q4: How does the free trial work?
Faq.a4: You get full access during the trial period. Track routines, save products, set reminders, and review summaries. No credit card required to start.
Faq.a5: Skintext detects your language from your message and responds accordingly. English and Swedish are supported, with more languages coming soon.

Privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Skintext ("Skintext", "we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.body:
When you use Skintext, we collect:

• Your phone number (to identify your account and deliver messages via iMessage)
• Your age band (16-17 or 18+), never your exact birthdate
• Your name, communication style, skin goals, skin type if shared, sensitivities, allergies, and current products
• Routine updates, product descriptions, reminders, timezone, and country for localization
• Routine logs, saved products, and one-variable skincare experiments
• Sanitized conversation history, which stores text and a generic marker for photo turns but not image bytes or private image URLs

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.body:
We use your data to:

• Provide skincare routine tracking and product guidance
• Remember your chosen communication style and relevant routine context
• Track one-variable skincare experiments and optional review reminders
• Generate routine summaries, adherence recaps, and reminders
• Process product labels and skin photos for the current reply
• Communicate with you via iMessage

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Security
dataStorage.body: Connections to our website and services use TLS (HTTPS). Your phone number is encrypted at rest using AES. Message history, routine log content, onboarding data during setup, saved products, experiments, and similar payloads are stored as encrypted application-layer blobs. Profile fields are stored with strict access controls. Photos are processed for the current reply by default and are not added to conversation history. Adults may separately opt into encrypted private photo retention for 30 days. Photo retention is unavailable to users aged 16-17.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body:
We use the following third-party services to operate Skintext:

• OpenAI — for image analysis and natural language processing
• Sendblue — for iMessage delivery

These services process data as necessary to provide our features. We do not sell your data to third parties.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain profile data, routine logs, products, experiments, and sanitized conversation history while your account is active unless you delete them. Adult photos retained with separate consent expire after 30 days. Turning off photo retention affects future photos; saved photos can be deleted separately. Deleting saved photos does not remove text derived from earlier photo discussions unless conversation history is also cleared.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body:
You have the right to:

• Ask what Skintext remembers and request a copy of your data
• Correct or forget profile fields and delete individual or all saved products
• Enable or disable future photo retention if you are 18+, and delete saved photos
• Clear conversation history after confirmation without deleting your profile
• Request deletion of your account, including experiments and privacy preferences
• Withdraw consent at any time

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at privacy@skintext.ai.

Terms.heading: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: By using Skintext ("Skintext", "the Service"), you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 16 years old and have access to an iPhone with iMessage to use Skintext. We ask only whether you are 16-17 or 18+. Users aged 16-17 receive additional safeguards and cannot enable cross-session photo retention.

service.title: The Service
service.body: Skintext is an AI-powered skincare routine assistant that operates through iMessage. The service includes routine logging, product notes, communication preferences, one-variable skincare experiments, summaries, adherence recaps, reminders, transient photo processing, and chat-based memory controls. Adult photo retention is optional and requires separate consent.

accuracy.title: Skincare Guidance
accuracy.body: Skintext provides routine support and conservative product guidance based on what you share. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional medical care. Consult a qualified clinician for concerning, severe, persistent, or rapidly changing symptoms.

account.title: Your Account
account.body: Your account is identified by your phone number. You are responsible for all activity associated with your phone number. Do not share access to your iMessage account with others for the purpose of using Skintext.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: All content, features, and functionality of Skintext are owned by Skintext and are protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Skintext is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service, including outcomes based on routine guidance provided by the service.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Skintext after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about these terms, contact us at support@skintext.ai.
